title: Inkor: emasman
hook_voice: Lesson eight. I'm not, he isn't, they aren't.
hook_say: Emas deyish uchun bitta so'z yetadi!

example.en: I'm not a teacher. I'm a student.

end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga to'qqizinchi dars: savol va qisqa javob.
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 8-dars: inglizcha «I'm not, He isn't, They aren't».

I'm not a doctor — Men shifokor emasman
He isn't happy — U xursand emas
They aren't students — Ular talaba emas

not = emas. isn't = is not, aren't = are not (qisqa shakllari).
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 9-dars: Savol va qisqa javob.
